title: Tech Note: Camera Security Surveillance System in 4D

historical_commentary.text: Only the teaser abstract is available for this note, so specifics are unconfirmed; given the era (pre-ORDA, 4D v15.x) and the fast pace of IP-camera protocol and codec change (RTSP/ONVIF/H.264-H.265 evolution, deprecation of ActiveX/QuickTime-style embedding), any concrete camera-integration code from 2016 is very likely obsolete or at minimum heavily outdated today.
